guide: Mine normal or Pure Ores in the Dwarven Mines.
You'll want to get as much Mining Speed
and Spread for this as you can.
Pickobulus is another great helper.
Once you acquire a Void Sword and a decent
armor like Ender or Glacite this should be
fairly easy to do.
For this you will need Combat 15.
To blow up crypts you can use
class abilities (Tank, Archer, Mage)
and/or Superboom TNTs that drop
from slaying Minibosses in dungeons
and can be bought from Walther in
The Deep Caverns or Ophelia in
The Dungeon Hub.
This needs Combat 15 and a completion
of the 2 previous floors to enter.
To efficiently grind this, you should
get help from Party Finder/Friends.
Carrots and potatoes from killing
Zombies in graveyard do count.
You can also kill Endermen in the End
for this for more Combat XP.
You'll want to get the highest Looting
and Luck enchant as you can on your weapon
for this for more frequent drops.
You will get the Rock Pet by mining 2.5k
Ore Blocks. Keep in mind that Stone doesn't
count for this. Don't forget to equip the pet ;)
Kill Sneaky Creepers in the Deep Caverns
for the first Gunpowder.
You might want to use as many minions
as you have access to for this.
Don't forget to fuel the minions,
give them storages and collect them in time.
You can also build a Creeper Farm on your
island, if you want to manual it.
Get yourself a splash, equip a Bingo Pet
and get the cake buff by eating the cakes
on skyerzz's or prtl's island.
If this doesn't finish it, get a Void Sword (200k) in the End
and hold it while some Ender Armor and/or Equipment.
For this you'll need to hit
25k Leather Collection and use
48 Enchanted Leather and 592 Leather
to craft it. Get the first Leather
from killing Cows on The Barn.
You can visit all Islands by using warp commands.
The Hub, Spider's Den, The End,
Gold Mine, Deep Caverns,
Farming Isles. Remember that some of them
require certain skill levels to enter.
Unlock Clay Minions by fishing in the Hub
in the Fishermans Pond. Then use the Clay Trade
to get enough Clay for minions.
You can also fish in the Backwater Bayou
for Clay from Treasures and Mobs.
Give them the best fuel and storage you
have access to. Using Compactors is strongly
recommended. Remember to collect in time.
To help with this, try to make bigger crafts
by hand for Carpentry levels.
Also do your daily experiments and make sure
to have a pet active at all times
(any pet works, even level 100).

note: Find 5 Pairs in the Experimentation Table
guide: Get Enchanting Level 10 and play
the first tier in the Experimentation Table.
Talk to Guildford in the Dungeon Hub
and complete 4/4 objectives of any 3 races.
Don't forget to talk to Guildford
after each run you do.
You'll want to use the free
Combat XP from Bestiary Milestones for this
aswell as the XP from /mobtypes.
Optimal tool:
Advanced Gardening Axe (25 copper)
Make a full plot of Cocoa Beans (16716 needed
or 105 enchanted) in The Garden (SkyBlock Level 5).
You will need Garden Level 8.
Get the Cocoa Beans to plant from The Desert Island.
Do your daily commissions in the Dwarven Mines
(4 per day). You will need Mining 12 for this.
Can also be completed in the Crystal Hollows,
though it might be harder to do so.
Start an Entrance floor and play Mage/Tank/Berserker to use
the classes abilities to kill a Lost Adventurer.
You only need to get the last hit
on it to count, so you can get help from your team.
You need Combat Level 15 to join a Dungeon.
Do commissions and events in The Dwarven Mines,
claim your daily powder from the Puzzler and
from giving Fetchur the items he asks for.
Fetchurs items are all listed in the Wiki.
Try to do those while a '2x Powder' event is active.
You might want to use the Royal Reforge on your
equipment to gain more powder from events.
You can also fish up and kill Mithril Grubbers
in the Abandoned Quarry (Fishing 6).

note: Obtain a Mediocre Ring of Love
guide: Follow the Romero Questline until you
get this. You will only need
1 Yellow Rock, 15 poppies and 64 Emerald.
Brew an Absorption IV potion
with an Enchanted Gold and combine it with a Glowstone.
You can get that Glowstone by buying one block
from the Builder and breaking it on your island.
Craft Leather, Iron, Gold and Diamond Armor
Buy Angler Armor (8 pieces) from Fishing Merchant
Craft Leaflet, Farm Suit, Mushroom and Cactus Armor

note: Obtain a Silver+ medal from Jacobs Contest
guide: Do contests like Wheat, Potato or Carrot.
You can also try to utilize pests to help here.
Talk to the Blacksmith in the Hub
and gamble Reforges on an armor piece
until you get the Titanic Reforge.
You might need to bring some money for this.
For this you will need 1 of each of the following Crystals:
Amethyst: Jungle Key and Temple Run
(the key can be obtained from Odawa as Garden Visitor,
or be bought from her in the Crystal Hollows)
Jade: Divan Mines and find all the tools
Amber: Find King, give him 1 goblin egg and find the Queen
Sapphire Crystal: 6 Robot Parts , give them to Professor Robot
(Electron Transmitter, FTX 3070, Robotron Reflector,
Superlite Motor, Control Switch, Synthetic Heart)
Topaz: Kill the Bal and get the Crystal after it dies,
you need to hit it at least once
§lFor all of this you will need HotM 4.
